articles.summary: ANTIOCH, Tenn., Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) today announced that John Meyne, the Company’s current Senior Vice President and President of its North America segment, has decided to retire as of December 31, 2026. The Company’s Board of Directors (the “Board”) has appointed Paul Shaw, currently the Senior Vice President of Operations of LKQ’s North America segment, to succeed Mr. Meyne effective January 1, 2027. “Paul has dedicated more than 25 years to LKQ, and his contributions have been instrumental in driving the growth of our North America segment. This well-deserved promotion reflects the confidence that our Board, senior management, and customers have in him,” said Mr. Meyne. Sal Abbate, LKQ’s President and Chief Executive Officer, commented: “We are pleased to announce Paul’s appointment as Senior Vice President of LKQ and President of North America. Paul has a proven track record of implementing operational discipline, deep industry expertise
articles.title: LKQ Corporation Announces New Leadership Appointment

articles.summary: ANTIOCH, Tenn., Nov. 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - LKQ Corporation (Nasdaq: LKQ) today announced that Salvatore A. “Sal” Abbate will assume the role of President and Chief Executive Officer and join the Company’s Board of Directors effective November 9, 2026, ahead of the previously announced start date of December 15, 2026. With Mr. Abbate’s arrival, the interim Office of the CEO, comprised of Chairman John Mendel and Audit Committee Chair Sue Gove, which has overseen the Company’s operations since October 23, will conclude. “I’m excited to be joining LKQ earlier than planned,” said Mr. Abbate. “LKQ has the scale and reach to be the first call for its customers. articles.title: Salvatore Abbate to Assume Role of LKQ President and CEO on November 9, 2026
